results.title: No Room For Love
results.overview: The Santiagos are a Filipino-American family of seven crammed into one tiny Los Angeles apartment, all chasing distant showbiz dreams. Bound by love and constant bickering, they navigate a turbulent year: isolation in spring, betrayal in summer, disaster at a fall party, and eviction in winter. No Room For Love is a comedy about big dreams, small spaces, and artists doing their best to survive poverty, bad luck, and each other - without ever giving up.

results.title: Falling
results.overview: Jack, while quick-witted, charming, and avoidant, finally risks opening his heart when he starts dating Jillian. He never expected, though, that his best friend Johnny would fall for her, too.

results.title: 102 Minutes: Inside the Towers
results.overview: Offers perspectives from survivors of the World Trade Center, timed to the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks.

results.title: Labyrinth
results.overview: Shiori is a typical high school student who dreams of online stardom, but struggles to capture attention. After an embarrassing video of her goes viral, she gets trapped in her smartphone and replaced by a charismatic alter ego. As the doppelganger charms the internet and devises a nefarious plot to replace mankind with brainrot, Shiori must partner with other online outcasts to stop her digital counterpart and reclaim her life in the real world.

results.title: Once Upon a Time in a Cinema
results.original_title: Once Upon a Time in a Cinema
results.overview: Earl Clancy, a cinema owner on the edge, battles a series of disasters while juggling personal turmoil and the chaos of a packed Friday night crowd. Told in real time over the course of the movie playing in the cinema (Breathless, starring Richard Gere).

results.title: A Night in Paradiso
results.overview: A one-of-a-kind immersive live theatre experience put to film. A 1970s variety talent show hosted by washed up actor, Dana Valentine, who finds himself haunted by a mysterious figure reminiscent of his old co-star, Finley Zopilote, taking the form of the role that was stolen from him.

results.title: Tenement
results.overview: As Junjun and Dodong try to make a living in Manila, they meet Rosa, their tenement landlady who gets in danger and has the brothers involved in a thrilling fight against hitmen.

results.title: There is Always a Monster
results.overview: A police investigation turns into a nightmare when a mutant creature unleashes terror inside the building.

results.title: Go for Broke 2
results.overview: After their children are brutalised, Sheila and her brother Su Cheng uncover a sinister conspiracy through perilous investigations. Battling for justice, they expose the corrupt network while finding redemption in their vengeful quest.

results.title: Double Trouble
results.overview: Two witty sisters in Vegas get tangled in a holiday heist and join forces with an ex-MI6 guard to outmaneuver a master thief and recover a diamond gauntlet before Christmas.

results.title: The Sphinx
results.overview: At an open mic night, a young comedian tries out new material when her estranged father shows up, seizing the stage to reveal a buried past and connect with the daughter he barely knows.

results.title: Nazar
results.overview: Harbir channels his envy of Ben by calling out his beliefs in Punjabi superstition and black magic at his cousin's birthday lunch. Harbir quickly finds there's more to this tale than he bargained for.

results.title: Criminals
results.overview: June, 1944, German-occupied Denmark. It has never been so dangerous to be part of the resistance. In a safe house, five fighters wait for comrades on a sabotage mission. When they do not return, and no news comes, fear begins to take hold.

results.title: HATERNET
results.overview: A group of nominated influencers participate in a streaming contest hosted by an energy drink brand, only to get hacked, locked in their rooms, and hunted physically and psychologically by anonymous online haters.

results.title: In Cold Light
results.overview: Fresh out of prison, Ava's attempt to reclaim her drug operation collapses when she witnesses a brutal crime, forcing her to flee into a nightmarish underworld where allies are scarce and enemies multiply by the minute.

results.title: Siccîn 9
results.overview: A mother's desperate cry to protect her child awakens an ancient, forbidden spell. As a horrific murder is concealed, the buried secret festers beneath the earth, transforming into a darker force. Years later, a mysterious death resurfaces the long-hidden sin: "The Seal of Bloodline."

results.title: Pewaris Susuk
results.overview: In a world full of power and influence, hidden dark secrets are inherited without choice. Seroja lives the perfect life, but is bound by a forbidden covenant that demands lifelong loyalty. Everything you own is a loan, and every loan comes with a price. Human greed is increasing. For the sake of strength, life is at stake. In the midst of confusion, Maya begins to unravel the mystery, she is unknowingly caught in a dangerous game. Faith weakens, and curiosity opens a door that cannot be closed. In a battle between blood and sacrifice... one must make the final choice.

results.title: Pirunduk
results.overview: A wronged wife in a remote village on the Tanah Banjar river, South Kalimantan. When she becomes a wandering spirit, she seeks revenge on those who have hurt her and collects debts that have not been paid off during her lifetime.
